comment: Pinned third-party runtimes for LoopForge Desktop. Fetch with: node scripts/fetch-vendors.js

git.name: Git for Windows MinGit (BusyBox)
git.why: LoopForge SOP script nodes run as `sh -lc`, git SSH helpers call `sh -c`, and some on-demand CLI installers run `bash -c`. Plain MinGit ships git.exe only. Official MinGit+busybox is the smallest official Git for Windows bundle that still provides a POSIX shell (busybox ash/sh and bash applets). Full PortableGit unpacked to ~323 MB; this bundle unpacks to ~84 MB. After extract, fetch-vendors adds ucrt64/bin/sh.exe (copy of the official git-wrapper/ash.exe so argv0 selects busybox sh) and ucrt64/bin/bash.exe (copy of busybox.exe so argv0 selects the bash applet). Do not copy the wrapper as bash.exe — that re-execs itself (fork-bomb).

getPip.name: get-pip.py (optional, copied next to the embeddable Python)

loopforge.note: Windows bins are built from this commit plus the desktop no-Docker / hidden-console patch. See scripts/build-loopforge-bins.js. The desktop installer ships only Windows binaries: agentflow.exe, agentflow-mcp.exe, agentflow-runner-windows-amd64, agentflow-gate-mcp-windows-amd64. Linux runner/gate-mcp and loopforge-account.exe are not packaged.
